# dbt-duckdb-telemetry-quality

**Work in progress.** A small data-quality project built with dbt and DuckDB on synthetic data.

**Everything here is synthetic and runs locally.** The events are generated by a script in this repo. No real systems, customers or employer data are involved, and nothing here is production.

## Status

Setup only. Nothing is built yet. The planned steps, in order:

- [ ] Synthetic event generator (with duplicates, late events and a missing column built in)
- [ ] dbt staging and mart models, one incremental model, one snapshot, source freshness checks
- [ ] Tests, including one that fails on the messy data and is then fixed
- [ ] One query timed before and after tuning
- [ ] GitHub Actions workflow running `dbt test`
- [ ] Dashboard on the marts
- [ ] Results section with numbers from a real run

## Rules for this repo

- All data is synthetic and local. Claims about scale, speed or results appear only after they are measured here.
- The commit history is real: failures are committed before their fixes, and history is not rewritten.

## About

Built by Enrique Hernandez as practice for analytics engineering work. I work as an Oracle database engineer. dbt, Python and cloud warehouses are skills I am still developing, and this project is how I am building them.
